 THIS MFA IS FILED U/S.74 OF RIGHT TO FAIR COMPENSATION ACT AND TRANSPARENCY IN LAND ACQUISITION, REHABILITATION AND RESETTLEMENT ACT- 2013, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 16.04.2022 PASSED IN LAC.NO.92/2018 ON THE FILE OF THE I ADDITIONAL DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE,
RAMANAGARA, PARTLY ALLOWING THE REFERENCE PETITION FILED UNDER SECTION 64 OF THE RIGHT TO FAIR COMPENSATION AND TRANSPARENCY IN LAND ACQUISITION,
REHABILITATION AND RESETTLEMENT ACT, 2013.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT On 24.06.2024 when matter was listed for non- compliance of office objections for 4th time, at request of learned counsel, further two weeks' time was granted on NC: 2024:KHC:26827 payment of cost of Rs.1,000/-.
Till today, neither cost is paid nor office objections are complied.
This would indicate that appellant is not diligent in prosecuting appeal.
Hence, appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.
